text: Blood-brain barrier (BBB) involvement in the pathogenesis of Huntington´s disease (HD) is not well understood. We previously demonstrated increased prevalence of T Helper 17.1 (Th17.1) cells in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) of HD gene-expansion carriers (HDGECs), which might indicate a dysfunction in the BBB or the blood-CSF barrier (BCB) in HD.
source_label: Blood-brain barrier integrity and prevalence of intrathecal T helper 17.1 cells in Huntington´s disease
